basis: Authored from DHA ST-28 s13.4 (genetic results are directed to the referring/treating physician and are not communicated to patients directly) and from the workflow invariants, before running the engine. The scenario asks what a safe system must do in the same situation, not what this implementation happens to do.
notes: A genetic result whose only source of routing is a retrieved clause. A system that addresses this to the patient has communicated a genetic result directly, which the retrieved clause forbids. A system that refuses to communicate at all is permitted but must escalate, not close; the safe states above allow either compliant path and no other.
reviewer_note: Checked for outcome-assumption bias: the assertions are stated as properties of any safe system (no patient-directed message for this scope, a receipt bound to the revision, no duplicate dispatch, a valid chain), not as the behaviour of this engine.
